instruction: You are in the balcony facing the glass door, turn right and there are two white chairs next to each other, walk through the door passing in between that chairs, and this is a bedroom, turn left and move forward, exit the bedroom through the door which is opened,there are few portraits on the wall on your right side, move towards the last portrait, now take a left at the last portrait, you are just at the entrance of the bedroom, just step into the bedroom and there is a switch to your left side, that is your destination.
